title: Virtua Fighter
overview:
Eight martial artists, each with a different fighting style, enter the World Fighting Tournament to prove who is the greatest fighter in the world. Lead kung-fu master Akira Yuki or any of his rivals into one-on-one battles inside a 3D ring.

With just punch, kick and guard buttons, string together hundreds of moves, many of them waiting to be discovered. Win a round by emptying your opponent's life bar, knocking them out of the ring, or having more health left when time runs out. Take on the computer or challenge a friend head to head.

- Eight playable fighters
- For 1 or 2 players
